Join Agnon House for a launch event of Dara Horn’s New York Times bestseller, The Final Solution to the Jewish Question: A Love Story for the Living (Simon & Schuster), a book that arrives at a moment when its questions could not be more urgent. Horn, the acclaimed novelist and essayist, will join Jeffrey Saks for a conversation about the volume’s alarming timeliness and the ways it speaks to, and challenges, contemporary Jewish life. We’ll consider how Horn’s deep engagement as a student and creator of Jewish literature gave rise to her keen insights to the existential challenges facing contemporary civilization, and how Jewish culture itself has traditionally understood its own agency in an often hostile world.

Sunday, December 13 (3 Tevet) at 12:00pm (Eastern) = 7:00pm (Israel) on Zoom. 

Dara Horn is the author of eight books, including the essay collection People Love Dead Jews and the novels The World to Come and Eternal Life. She is the recipient of three National Jewish Book Awards, and her work has appeared in The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, The Atlantic, and many other publications. She received her doctorate in Hebrew and Yiddish literature from Harvard University, and has taught Jewish literature at Sarah Lawrence, Yeshiva University, and Harvard.
Jeffrey Saks is Director of Research at Agnon House.

Participation free with Zoom registration (above). Program in English.
